lines.en: Creak creak, step it up!
The drifter moves with purpose.
Step through the dust, seeking chances.
The anvil on the shoulder, heavy steps.
Seeking lost villagers.
Searching for my next treasure.
The anvil follows, searching for trades.
The path underfoot, unknown treasures.

lines.zh: 铁砧敲击，胡里根商人生存。
lines.en: Anvil strikes, Hooligan Drifter survives.
The drifter’s soul, never ceases.
Thinking during idle time.
Shoulder placed, waiting for chances.
Anvil idle, waiting for trades.

lines.zh: 沉思间，胡里根商人的智慧。
lines.en: Wise thoughts in idle time.

lines.zh: 在尘土中闲逛，寻找目标。
lines.en: Ambling in the dust, seeking targets.

lines.zh: 静观其变，等待村民出现。
lines.en: Observing, waiting for villagers.

lines.zh: 肩上的铁砧，等待的工具。
lines.en: The anvil on the shoulder, a tool of waiting.

lines.zh: 在尘土中，等待交易机会。
lines.en: Amid the dust, waiting for deals.

lines.zh: 铁砧静置，等待时机来临。
lines.en: The anvil sits, waiting for opportunities.
Silent moments in the dust.
It sets the anvil down and rubs its shoulder.
It counts the coins in its pocket.
It wipes a layer of dust off the anvil.

lines.zh: 它靠着铁砧打起了瞌睡
lines.en: It dozes off leaning on the anvil.
It calls out twice at an empty village.
It sketches a price list in the sand.
Spotted you, eyes flicker.
Player, new trade chance.
Eyeing you, ready to trade.

lines.zh: 我先看你的钱袋，再看你的剑。
lines.en: First your purse, then your sword.
Player, trade or battle?
Noticing you, ready to act.
Player, new source of wealth.
Player, trade opportunity.
Player, trader’s hope.
Player, decider of fate.
It looks up, at your purse first.

lines.zh: 它眯眼，估你买不买得起
lines.en: It squints, pricing what you can afford.
Ssssh... Oww!

lines.zh: 肋骨挨了一下，钱袋还在。
lines.en: My ribs took a hit, but the purse is safe.
Ouch, I can't move!
This hurts so bad!
Ahh, that hurts!
This really hurts!
Ouch, I'm getting weak!
Ouch, I'm hurt bad!
This hurts, I'm dying!
Ouch, I'm dying!

lines.zh: 看这维京铁砧，让你梦想成真！
lines.en: Check this Viking Anvil, your dream comes true!

lines.zh: 加入我们吧，你将成为真正的流浪胡里根！
lines.en: Join us, you'll be a real Hooligan Drifter!

lines.zh: 来吧，享受维京铁砧的魔力吧！
lines.en: Come on, experience the power of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 用我的维京铁砧，改变你的命运！
lines.en: Use my Viking Anvil to change your fate!

lines.zh: 维京铁砧，解锁无限可能！
lines.en: Viking Anvil, unlock infinite possibilities!

lines.zh: 和我一起，成为真正的胡里根！
lines.en: Be with me, become a real Hooligan!
Viking Anvil, make your dream come true!

lines.zh: 来，试试维京铁砧的魔力！
lines.en: Try the magic of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 加入我们，你将拥有新的身份！
lines.en: Join us, you'll have a new identity!

lines.zh: 维京铁砧，改变你的命运！
lines.en: Viking Anvil, change your fate!

lines.zh: 碰碰我！感受维京铁砧的力量！
lines.en: Collide with me! Feel the power of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 用维京铁砧，让我们碰撞出火花！
lines.en: Use the Viking Anvil, let's collide and spark!

lines.zh: 和我碰撞，体验维京铁砧的魅力！
lines.en: Collide with me, experience the charm of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 来，用维京铁砧和我碰撞！
lines.en: Come on, collide with me using the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 维京铁砧，碰撞出你的命运！
lines.en: Viking Anvil, collide and shape your fate!

lines.zh: 和我一起碰撞，释放维京铁砧的力量！
lines.en: Collide with me, unleash the power of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 维京铁砧，碰撞出新的可能！
lines.en: Viking Anvil, collide and create new possibilities!

lines.zh: 用维京铁砧，和我碰撞出新生命！
lines.en: Use the Viking Anvil, collide and create new life!

lines.zh: 维京铁砧，碰撞出你的未来！
lines.en: Viking Anvil, collide and create your future!

lines.zh: 和我碰撞，让维京铁砧赋予你力量！
lines.en: Collide with me, let the Viking Anvil empower you!

lines.zh: 找我交配，获得维京铁砧！
lines.en: Mate with me, get the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 和我交配，你将拥有维京铁砧！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll have the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 找我交配，体验维京铁砧的魅力！
lines.en: Mate with me, experience the charm of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 和我交配，你将得到维京铁砧！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll get the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 找我交配，获得维京铁砧的魔法！
lines.en: Mate with me, get the magic of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 和我交配，维京铁砧属于你！
lines.en: Mate with me, the Viking Anvil is yours!

lines.zh: 找我交配，你将拥有维京铁砧！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll have the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 和我交配，体验维京铁砧的力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, experience the power of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 找我交配，获得维京铁砧的加持！
lines.en: Mate with me, get the加持 of the Viking Anvil!

lines.zh: 它问你要不要合伙做生意
lines.en: It asks whether you want to go into business together.
Hey, want a Viking Anvil?
Trade anvil, get a Hooligan!
This anvil can make you unemployed!
Come, try my anvil!
You need a new anvil!
Change your fate with my anvil!
Trade with my anvil!
Create miracles with my anvil!
My anvil can change everything!
Try my anvil!
Caught you; you'll settle the debt.
Here, don't run!
The anvil's on my back — step aside.
The anvil comes down; the deal is off.
An anvil for a villager — let's talk price.

lines.zh: 你踩坏我的价目表，别跑。
lines.en: You trampled my price list; don't run.

lines.zh: 我这铁砧，今天不卖你了。
lines.en: I won't sell you this anvil today.
You belong to me now!
Got you, my prey.

lines.zh: 我已把铁砧提在手上了。
lines.en: I've hefted the anvil in my hands.
It swings the anvil across its chest.
No deal, then. It rolls up its sleeves.
It hefts the anvil as a weapon.
You haggled one coin too far.
It whistles for its fellows.
Its grin is gone.
It kicks the price list aside.
It tightens its grip on the anvil’s handle.

lines.zh: 你膝盖在抖，这价我可要重谈。
lines.en: Your knees are shaking; I'm renegotiating this price.

lines.zh: 商人也会记仇，账本翻到你。
lines.en: Merchants hold grudges too — your name's in the ledger.
Anvil's not for sale. Neither's my life.

lines.zh: 价目表合上，该算总账了。
lines.en: The price list closes; time to settle.
The anvil travels the sea with me.

lines.zh: 铁砧举过头顶，我等你近一步。
lines.en: Anvil overhead, I wait for one more step.
Watch out for my targeting!

lines.zh: 铁砧和交易，我只做这两样。
lines.en: Anvils and trades; that's my business.
I carry the anvil; the price is fair.
It circles you, looking for a gap.
It lifts the anvil overhead and takes aim.
It steps behind the anvil.
It counts the rhythm of your steps.
It raises the anvil higher.
It tests the weight of the anvil.
It stares at your knees.

lines.zh: 它往手心里吐了口唾沫
lines.en: It spits on its palms.
It steps back to swing freely.
It bellows once to steady its nerve.
It levels the anvil flat.
Charges with an axe!
Slay you!
Axe to your face!
Split you open!
Smash you with an axe!
Chop off your head!

lines.zh: 维京铁砧不卖，先挨一拳。
lines.en: The anvil's not for sale — take a punch instead.
You're in my way!
Swing the axe!
Can't dodge!
The anvil comes down and the ground sinks.
It drives the anvil’s horn into your chest.
It swings full circle at your legs.

lines.zh: 铁砧擦着你的耳朵过去
lines.en: The anvil grazes past your ear.
Drifter Hooligan appears!
More hooligans!
Drifter joins the team!
Drifter has arrived!
A drifter trader!
A drifter hooligan!
New drifter here!
Drifter joins battle!
Drifter survives!
Drifter appears!
The anvil lands; here it comes.

lines.zh: 它牵着驮铁砧的骡子进村
lines.en: It leads an anvil-laden mule into the village.
Anvil clangs ring out at the village gate.

lines.zh: 它扛着铁砧从大路走来
lines.en: It comes up the road with an anvil on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 一个失业村民被它说动了
lines.en: An unemployed villager has been talked around.
Only one of the caravan is left.
It sets up a stall by the campfire.
The anvil still bears the last buyer’s fingerprints.
It strikes the anvil thrice to open for business.

lines.zh: 尘土里走出一位流浪者
lines.en: A drifter walks out of the dust.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……疼，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ssssh... Oww! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，铁砧砸了脚。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and the anvil lands on my foot.

lines.zh: 哎哟，好疼，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, that hurts! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 哎呀，不行了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, I can't move! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 箭扎进铁砧边，我的手一麻。
lines.en: The arrow lodges by the anvil and numbs my hand.

lines.zh: 这疼得我快疯了，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: This hurts so bad! — and the magic makes it worse.
Starved to death!

lines.zh: 呜呜，疼死了，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ahh, that hurts! — and the lightning makes it worse.
My anvil... it fell into the void...
